title: atoll mergerfs-config --json
description: The mergerfs configuration of the merged view, for phase 1 and break glass (specs.md §21.1, §25).

branches.description: The data disks, in configuration order.

options.description: Each option as key=value, in the order of specs.md §21.1.

largest_file_bytes.description: The size of the largest file the catalog knows, or null when it knows none.

fstab.description: The line the command prints without --json, with no line feed: branches, mount point, type, options, 0 and 0, with what fstab(5) needs escaped.

minfreespace_bytes.description: What placement.min_free keeps free on the disk, or null when the branch has none of its own: its capacity was never recorded and min_free holds no size.
